title: Align changelog sign-off, customer-facing messaging, and launch assets for runtime-1.22
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Prepare and coordinate internal sign-off and customer-facing changelogs for the runtime-1.22 release. Deliverables: 1) internal release brief for Sales/Support/PS, 2) public changelog entry (concise + expanded notes), 3) annotated PR/upgrade guidance, 4) launch assets for marketing (banner copy + tweet thread). Primary stakeholders: Engineering (runtime and infra), Design, Legal/Compliance, Marketing, Support. Goal is synchronized launch with clear rollback messaging and guidance for Dedicated/Private customers.

Include explicit note about Private deployments: KMS/HSM compatibility and no change to customer data residency.
